results.title: A systematic review of docetaxel efficacy in HER2-negative breast cancer
results.abstract: This systematic review found docetaxel produced a significant improvement in pathological complete response rates across several trials.

results.title: Resistance mechanisms to docetaxel in triple-negative breast cancer
results.abstract: Acquired resistance to docetaxel was observed in a subset of patients, associated with upregulation of ABCB1.
